scope: Experimental encrypted operator wallet and single-use purchased-byte ledger, actual local BFT Node/Native/QC funding and canonical-store reopening; encrypted shared meter and signed connection-admission storage. No private live authority, client/control or funded kernel route claim.
implemented: Separately held zeroizing master key; domain-separated wallet identity, database, row, claimant, spend, nonce and meter keys
Whole-record XChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption with fresh OS nonces and immutable scope AAD; wrong-key/scope, swaps and tampering refused
SQLite sees encrypted invoice, channel, credit and historical proof records plus scoped pseudorandom tags; WAL and FULL-synchronous atomic financial updates
Existing-only recovery and exclusive writer lease; missing lease, symlink paths and replaced database refuse accidental reset
Durable key-slot and quote-ceiling reservation precedes returning operator/claimant signatures
Within one wallet database, one canonical note credits once under concurrent retries; extra real payments to an invoice remain owned but cannot grant duplicate bytes
Recovered purchased-byte floors are revalidated against actual canonical private funding before meter use
Encrypted prepaid meter journals retain signed connection watermarks, consumed and uncertain bytes; wrong-key/plaintext fallback and purchase regression refuse
Encrypted meter selection in the shared service; signed connection admission storage/recovery regression uses an explicit canonical-host fixture
Actual Node/Native/QC test covers speculative refusal, encrypted wallet reopen, two genuine payments to one invoice, stable one-time key slots and full canonical/ExEx-store reopen
remaining: Private client/operator control and current-lease guarded live authority integration
Zero-price grants and self-carried traffic without dummy paid notes
Automatic key custody/backup tooling and spending received wallet notes through the wallet API
Concurrent root scheduling/retries and funded private multi-node/kernel/restart qualification
Public devnet/mainnet and alternate-host qualification, production ceremony and adversarial cryptographic review
limits: Available local quote ceiling is not an on-chain balance; invoice signatures alone grant no bytes
Encryption at rest does not protect an unlocked process or hide file sizes, record counts, row grouping or IO timing
No rollback protection against a privileged restore/cloned copy of the complete wallet and meter history; do not reactivate old backups as fresh live writers
Master key must be held separately; losing it loses access to derived one-time spend keys
Current released shielded_required route remains refused before reading keys/journals
No deployment, public source compilation or GitHub push performed in this stage

prior_native_qualification.reason: This stage changes storage, private invoice codec and host wallet/meter accounting, not the proven pool circuit/AML/Lean sources.

prior_test_failure.fix: Only the overflow fixture now has ten seconds for startup; deadline branch remains one second and production limits are unchanged. Full suite rerun passed.
